text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Ramonu... I hope this
will be a
joyful and successful year for
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it's an honor to hear from you.
But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I must say, your well-wishes are usually
more...
verbose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Every year, I struggle with what to say
on your
birthday. I fear I have been
hiding those feelings
and many more
behind flowery words.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So this year, I chose to express myself
plainly and
honestly... Was it
insufficient?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...This reminds me of when you were
younger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...A crescent moon bearing a crown of
flowers, her
innocent radiance glowing
softly within.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...But even so, her faint glow could never
light up
the hidden depths of the
mountain that towered
in the night.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Nor is it her responsibility to do so. Does
the
moon know this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She knows this now. That's why the
moon chose to
descend—to become one
with the earth and
support the mountain
as well as everything it
towers over.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is why I offer my wishes to you now,
under
the brilliant light of the sun...
Happy birthday,
Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I see that no matter how much
you try to
hold it in, the core of you
never changes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Rudolf. I'm grateful to
receive your
kind words.
